name: FORENSYRA
motto: Preserve the Trace. Prove the Story.
description: FORENSYRA is a collective for students and early-career professionals in digital forensics, incident response, and evidence-led investigation. We learn together, practise on legal and authorised mock cases, build public projects, and grow into a strong DFIR team.

announcement.text: Applications are open — join the founding team and help build the first student-led DFIR collective.
